probes.probe_description: Compares the full replay's equity curve against a truncated replay missing the final quarter of bars; any divergence over the shared prefix would prove a future bar influenced an earlier decision.
Reruns the replay with deterministic +/-20bps per-bar microstructure noise and measures the return degradation versus the unperturbed baseline.
Reruns the replay with slippage and the flat fee doubled and measures the return degradation.
Reruns the replay with the entry threshold shifted +/-10bps and measures the largest resulting return swing.
Reruns the replay with a -15% price shock applied from a seed-selected bar onward and measures the return degradation.
